subject: Data Engineering
title: Topics and Partitions
description: A quick win: understand Topics and Partitions.

hook.text: One Kafka topic handles a million events per second. How? It splits the work across partitions.

buildup.text: A topic is a named stream of events. Partitions divide that stream into parallel segments.

discovery.text: Each partition is an ordered, immutable log. More partitions mean more parallel consumers.

twist.text: Order is guaranteed only within a partition. Events across partitions may arrive in any order.

climax.text: Choosing the right partition key ensures related events stay ordered while spreading load evenly.

punchline.text: Partitions trade global order for parallel speed.

quiz.question: What do partitions in Kafka enable?
